findings.title: Loop totals omit earlier iterations
findings.description: The report reads only persisted `action_results`. Loop execution stores earlier iterations in `StepResult.prior_rounds`, which `StateManager._append_step()` does not persist. A two-round reproduction costing $1 and $2 reported only $2. Persist and include every round’s usage, with regression coverage.

findings.title: Split reviews count only the first part
findings.description: Each part receives usage, but `fold_review_parts()` copies only the first part’s metadata without summing usage. Two parts costing $1 and $2 produced a $1 record. Their artifacts are also excluded from standalone statistics by `runId`, so the omitted spend appears nowhere. Aggregate all parts before persistence.

findings.title: Failed split-review parts violate the folding contract
findings.description: The newly returned failure result has empty outputs and, for ordinary reviews, no verdict. Multi-part folding requires an input file, response, and verdict for every part. Reproduction raised `TypeError: review part must name exactly one input file, got []`, replacing the provider failure and discarding captured usage. Handle failed parts explicitly and test a mixed successful/failed review.

findings.title: Fan-out reduction discards captured branch usage
findings.description: Passing capture into branches is insufficient: only the reducer’s result is persisted. `CollectReducer` strips branch metadata, while `FirstPassReducer` also returns no usage metadata. Consequently, statistics omit branch spend without even counting those calls as unrecorded LLM actions. Preserve branch usage independently of the selected reduction.

findings.title: Failed compaction drops available telemetry
findings.description: Usage is stamped only after successful compaction. A `ProviderError` carrying completed-turn telemetry returns empty metadata instead; a reproduction confirmed this. Capture error telemetry before returning failure, and preserve summary spend if subsequent reconnection fails.

findings.title: Malformed cost basis crashes the entire review report
findings.description: A YAML list or mapping in `costBasis` reaches set membership and raises `TypeError` because it is unhashable. This bypasses the documented warning-and-`None` behavior. Validate that the value is a string before membership testing; cover list and mapping inputs.
